title: IFC-BANK-D-RE: square-root epochs with charged repeated renumbering

claims.statement: For every N>=2, n=ceil(log2 N), and s in Z/NZ, the ONE physical IFC-BANK-D-RE program fully specified in proof.md and virtual.md, virtual2.md, virtual3.md uses EW=ceil(sqrt n)-bit physical lazy epoch words, the exact renumbering and indexed slot bank, and the unchanged complete IFC-LIMIT-D reference program P. It outputs the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 under independent ideal coset inputs. On EVERY branch, including all failed/aborted/recycled trials, initialization, metadata, source swaps, address/circuit generation and final disposal, jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims, total charged sequential time is O(n^12 2^((1521/1000)sqrt n)); Sections 9-10 derive n^6 C_P with C_P=O(n^6 2^((1521/1000)sqrt n)), using separately charged acquisition instructions and amortized repeated exact renumbering. The declared envelope has growth index 1/2.

For every N>=2, n=ceil(log2 N), and s in Z/NZ, the ONE physical IFC-BANK-D-RE program fully specified in proof.md and virtual.md, virtual2.md, virtual3.md uses EW=ceil(sqrt n)-bit physical lazy epoch words, the exact renumbering and indexed slot bank, and the unchanged complete IFC-LIMIT-D reference program P. It outputs the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 under independent ideal coset inputs. On EVERY branch, including all failed/aborted/recycled trials, initialization, metadata, source swaps, address/circuit generation and final disposal, jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims, peak ordinary classical space is O(n) bits, including input/output and every staged address/arithmetic/controller word; all persistent P data and metadata live in counted qubits. Its envelope has growth index 0.

For every N>=2, n=ceil(log2 N), and s in Z/NZ, the ONE physical IFC-BANK-D-RE program fully specified in proof.md and virtual.md, virtual2.md, virtual3.md uses EW=ceil(sqrt n)-bit physical lazy epoch words, the exact renumbering and indexed slot bank, and the unchanged complete IFC-LIMIT-D reference program P. It outputs the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 under independent ideal coset inputs. On EVERY branch, including all failed/aborted/recycled trials, initialization, metadata, source swaps, address/circuit generation and final disposal, jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims, peak allocated quantum space is O(n^-31 2^((83/160)sqrt n)) qubits. Section 8 counts the entire fixed prefix, tags/epochs/flags/backup/scratch, all live/free/never-used slots and padding, plus the acquisition register. Its envelope has growth index 1/2.

For every N>=2, n=ceil(log2 N), and s in Z/NZ, the ONE physical IFC-BANK-D-RE program fully specified in proof.md and virtual.md, virtual2.md, virtual3.md uses EW=ceil(sqrt n)-bit physical lazy epoch words, the exact renumbering and indexed slot bank, and the unchanged complete IFC-LIMIT-D reference program P. It outputs the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 under independent ideal coset inputs. On EVERY branch, including all failed/aborted/recycled trials, initialization, metadata, source swaps, address/circuit generation and final disposal, jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims, total original source acquisitions are O(n^(7/2) 2^((1521/1000)sqrt n)), including all rejected/discarded copies and aborted attempts. Exactly one acquisition is made per logical P request; bookkeeping adds none. Its envelope has growth index 1/2.

The SAME ONE IFC-BANK-D-RE program and all FOUR simultaneous every-branch resource bounds have proved clean-input fractional tolerance epsilon(n)=0: every acquisition is an independent ideal coset copy. For every N,s, unconditional ENTIRE-secret recovery has probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
